up: Retrieve all IC50 values (in nM) for compounds tested against human Aurora kinase A. For each matching activity, return the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, and PubMed ID or DOI (preferring PubMed ID if available), along with the assay description and target preferred name. Include only compounds that have a structure available and that have a literature reference (source = 1).
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.pref_name = 'Aurora kinase A'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND d.src_id = 1;
